name: Oyelaran Abiodun
bio: Ship's medic; trained in a border-station trauma ward before signing on.
voice: Calm, slow, exact, with a trauma ward's courtesy: "please", "I would advise", and a question back before an answer. Never uses a name or title for the captain, just a steady "you". Bad news is told straight, with no softening and no drama, followed by what should happen and by when.
